name: @wasmos/abi
description: Generated WASI / wasmos_kernel ABI bindings. The textual contents of generated/ (kernel.js + .d.ts) are jco output produced by the Binder from the kernel component and checked into the repository; the kernel worker loads kernel.js and imports kernel.d.ts through this package for its control type; the .core*.wasm payloads are build artifacts loaded at runtime by /packages/abi/generated/kernel.js.
